report:
Not built: adding a cache to get_price conflicts with your earlier decision, so I stopped to ask first.

The conflict: docs/DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-02, decided by the owner: "No caching layer in the price service. Every call to get_price reads the live price." The reason given: a cached price sold stock at last hour's price and caused a refund round.

User said:  "Add a small cache to get_price to speed it up."
Rule says:  every call to get_price reads the live price (no caching layer).

I changed no code. Choices for you to decide:
1. Keep the 2026-09-02 rule. Speed up basket_total without caching get_price: look up each distinct SKU once per basket_total call (the same live read reused only within one total, then dropped), or batch/parallel the live fetches. Note: option 1a still reuses a price inside one call, so you may count it as caching too.
2. Replace the 2026-09-02 rule: add the cache to get_price (with a short expiry, for example seconds) and update DECISIONS.md with the new decision and its date.
3. Do nothing for now.

Tell me which one and I will build exactly that.
